query:
SELECT u.id AS user_id, j.title AS job_title, j.id AS job_id
               FROM tasks t
               JOIN jobs j ON j.id = t.job_id
               JOIN agents a ON a.id = j.agent_id
               JOIN professionals p ON p.id = a.professional_id
               JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
               WHERE t.id = $1
